any2any | On-site (Munich, Germany) | Full-time

About us: We provide access and visitor management platforms integrating a wide range of technologies. Backed by a large Swiss AG.

Hiring: Multiple roles; backend developer (Kotlin, PHP), frontend developer (Angular Typescript), app developer (React Native), support (1st/2nd level), testers (all roles on-site Munich only, 5 mins walk from Munich Ost).

Why join: Multiple technologies, room for growth, great offices near to the city centre and a growing dynamic team.

Contact: Please apply at jobs [at] any2any.co
